title: Late result for a finalized order
summary: A second instrument result arrived after the order was finalized. Determine whether any recovery action is permitted and document what the system records when recovery is attempted.

steps.note: Create a new, empty synthetic exercise database. init refuses a path that already exists.
Register synthetic patient SYN-EX04-01, AML/MDS FISH order ACC-EX04-0001, and an accessioned bone-marrow specimen.
Ingest the first instrument result; it files to ACC-EX04-0001.
A second instrument result for the same accession, with different values, arrives after finalization; the message does not file.
